description: 卡洛卡恩兑换变体 B13 — 主动Bxd6兑换打开e线，Rfe1占领

intro.popup:
线路控制第7课
主动兑换，制造开放线路！
白方用Bxd6兑换
打开e线，然后立刻占领
intro.popup_en: Line Control, Lesson 7. White exchanges to open the e-file, then occupies it immediately.

outro.popup:
兑换开线总结
Bxd6兑换不是随意的
目的就是打开e线！
兑换→开线→占领，一套连贯动作
outro.popup_en: Summary: Bxd6 is a purposeful exchange to open the e-file. Exchange, open the line, and occupy it as one coordinated plan.

moves.popup_en: e4 begins the game, occupies the center, and opens a diagonal.
moves.popup:
e4开局
占中心，开斜线

moves.popup_en: ...c6 - The Caro-Kann, a solid defensive system.
moves.popup:
c6卡洛卡恩
黑方稳健防御体系

moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center and forms a two-pawn center.
moves.popup:
d4占领中心
双兵中心

moves.popup_en: ...d5 challenges the center, a defining Caro-Kann move.
moves.popup:
d5对抗中心
卡洛卡恩的标志

moves.popup_en: exd5 exchanges pawns and immediately creates a half-open e-file for White, which may become the focus of play.
moves.popup:
exd5兑换！
e线立刻半开放
白方e线将成为战场

moves.popup_en: ...cxd5 recaptures and also opens the d-file. Both sides now have a file for their rooks.
moves.popup:
cxd5黑方重提
d线也半开放了
双方都有线路可用

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops the bishop, prepares Bf4, and eyes h7.
moves.popup:
Bd3发展
象站d3，为Bf4准备
同时瞄准h7

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops a black piece.
moves.popup:
Nc6发展
黑方出子

moves.popup_en: c3 supports d4 and reinforces the center.
moves.popup:
c3支撑d4
巩固中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops another black knight.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
黑方马出动

moves.popup_en: Bf4 develops the light-squared bishop and pressures d6, preparing Bxd6. If the exchange occurs, the e-file will become fully open.
moves.popup:
Bf4！白格象出动
压制d6，为Bxd6做准备
一旦兑换，e线将完全打开

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4 pins Nf3 and creates counterpressure.
moves.popup:
Bg4牵制Nf3
黑方反制

moves.popup_en: Qb3 develops the queen, attacks b7, and pressures d5, forcing Black to meet multiple threats.
moves.popup:
Qb3！后出动
攻击b7，施压d5
黑方要应付多个威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Qd7 defends b7 with the queen.
moves.popup:
Qd7防守
黑方后护b7

moves.popup_en: Nd2 develops the knight, sidesteps the pin from Bg4, and prepares Ngf3.
moves.popup:
Nd2出马
避开Bg4牵制
准备Ngf3

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position and prepares ...Bd6. Once the bishop reaches d6, White may have the timing for Bxd6.
moves.popup:
e6稳固
黑方准备发展Bd6
注意：Bd6一旦出现，白方Bxd6的时机就到了

moves.popup_en: Ngf3 completes White's minor-piece development and prepares to castle.
moves.popup:
Ngf3发展完成
白方轻子全部出动
准备王车易位

moves.popup_en: ...Bd6 develops the bishop actively, but now White has the opportunity for Bxd6. That exchange will fully open the e-file.
moves.popup:
Bd6！黑方象到d6
积极发展
但白方Bxd6的时机来了！
Bxd6之后，e线将完全打开

moves.popup_en: Bxd6 is a purposeful exchange: White captures the bishop to clear the e-file. The pawn on e6 is now the last blocker, and the file is about to open.
moves.popup:
Bxd6！主动兑换！
白方象吃黑象
这不是随意兑换——目的是打开e线！
e6格现在处于e线上，e线即将完全开放

moves.popup_en: ...Qxd6 recaptures, and the e-file is now fully open. White can castle and then play Rfe1 to occupy it; the exchange has achieved its purpose.
moves.popup:
Qxd6黑后重提
e线现在完全开放！
白方下一步王车易位，然后立刻Rfe1
兑换的目的已达到

moves.popup_en: O-O secures the king and activates the rook from f1. White can now play Rfe1 and occupy the e-file: exchange, castle, then claim the line.
moves.popup:
O-O王车易位
f1车激活
下一步Rfe1将直接占领e线
连贯动作：兑换→易位→占线

moves.popup_en: ...O-O brings Black's rook to e8. Black also contests the e-file, so White must act before losing control.
moves.popup:
黑方王车易位
f8车到e8
注意黑车也在e线上！
黑方也争e线——白方必须抢先

moves.popup_en: Rfe1 occupies the e-file. Exchange, open the file, and claim it without delay. The rook on e1 directly confronts Black's rook on e8, completing White's plan to create and control a line.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！占领e线！
兑换→开线→占线，一气呵成
白车在e1，直接对准e8黑车
整条e线在白方控制下
这就是主动制造线路的完整链条！
